title: polyscias excelsa
intro: Polyscias excelsa, commonly known as the Tāne or Kauri tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae, native to the tropical forests of the Pacific Islands. The leaves of the Polyscias excelsa plant have been traditionally used in folk medicine for their potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, aiding in wound healing and reducing fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and act as an anti-histamine. The bioactive constituents of Polyscias excelsa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
